pr_body:
This commit skips settings validation during desired nodes updates. The issue comes when a setting that needs to be validated depends on a secure setting that cannot be read while the desired nodes are updated. To avoid such issues, we'll skip the settings validations completely.

Closes #96127
pr_title: Skip settings validation during desired nodes updates
